summary: The chat reopened after a fully silent week, but every message was about money. Stephski chased the July 15-31 invoice twice (Aug 9 and Aug 11, the second with a pause-in-work warning); Chey asked for a 4-day extension because she is waiting on her OnlyFans payout, making this the third consecutive late invoice and the latest one yet — 14 days out at week end with the extension landing on Aug 15, the same day the next invoice goes out, so two periods will stack into one bill. Michelle delivered the weekly leak-removal breakdown, the only piece of service delivery posted all week. Nothing at all was posted on the Social Media or Promo side: Derrek's Aug 1 promise of 'plenty of updates starting next week' on the $40k phone-farm rollout produced zero updates in the week it was due, so the client has now gone two weeks with a paused IG program, no status, and no visible restart. The Jul 13 PayPal question is still unanswered at 32 days, which is directly relevant now that payment friction is the account's main issue.
